investigation_summary.primary_typology: Russia Sanctions Evasion | Pandemic Loan Fraud | TBML Transshipment | Nominee Shell

nodes.id: string (maps to Sayari REST `id`; the connector calls it `entity_id`)
nodes.label: string (maps to Sayari `label`; English translation in `translated_label`)
nodes.type: public_recipient | shell_intermediary | nominee_person | sanctioned_entity | transshipment_hub | address_hub | facilitator

sayari_pass_through.sanctioned: boolean - native Sayari flag, true if entity is on a sanctions list
sayari_pass_through.pep: boolean - native Sayari flag, true if entity is a politically exposed person
sayari_pass_through.closed: boolean - true if a closed/dissolved status was parsed for this entity (phoenix-entity signal)
sayari_pass_through.degree: integer - number of outgoing relationships (facilitator fan-out / address concentration signal)
sayari_pass_through.relationship_count: object - Sayari count of related entities per relationship type, e.g. {"has_shareholder": 3} (replaces edge_counts, which is not in the Sayari REST spec)
sayari_pass_through.num_documents: integer - number of documents referencing the entity

nodes.entity_count: integer, only for type=address_hub - number of distinct entities sharing this exact normalized address, counted by the application (Sayari has no address entity type)
nodes.directorship_count: integer, only for type=nominee_person - number of active board seats across unrelated entities

risk_signals.provenance_source: Sayari | Tradeverifyd | Tavily (the tool that retrieved the record)
risk_signals.evidence_record: string (must be a real URI or dataset record ID)
risk_signals.source_authority: string, optional (who published the record, e.g. OFAC, DOJ, Companies House)

edges.relationship_type: BENEFICIAL_OWNER | SHAREHOLDER | OFFICER_DIRECTOR | SUPPLY_CHAIN_SHIPMENT | SHARED_ADDRESS | SHARED_OFFICER | REGISTERED_AGENT_FOR | POSSIBLY_SAME_AS | ACTING_ON_BEHALF_OF | OWNS_OR_CONTROLS | LINKED_TO
edges.ownership_percentage: null | number (maps to Sayari shares struct)
edges.position: string, only for OFFICER_DIRECTOR (maps to Sayari position struct - officer/director title)
edges.match_keys: array of {key, normalized, original} objects, only for POSSIBLY_SAME_AS (maps to Sayari possibly_same_as[].match_keys - the specific attributes that triggered the match, e.g. name variant, address, registration number)
edges.former: boolean - true if the relationship has ended
edges.provenance_ref: string (must be a real URI or dataset record ID)
edges.source_authority: string, optional (who published the record, e.g. OFAC)

_known_gap: primary_typology enum has no clean/low-risk value - see README
_sayari_alignment_note: Node and edge fields above are structured to accept Sayari bulk-data/API fields directly (id, label, translated_label, sanctioned, pep, closed, degree, relationship_count, shares, position, possibly_same_as.match_keys - checked against docs/vendor/sayari/openapi.yml on 2026-09-25) with minimal transformation. POSSIBLY_SAME_AS is Sayari's native relationship type for probable identity matches - use match_keys as the real confidence evidence instead of an invented percentage.
